name: retained-earnings-proxy
notes: Retained earnings proxy: (BE_t - BE_{t-1y}) / TA_{t-1y}. Growing book equity = profitable AND not paying out all profits. Distinct from H207 shareholder yield (buybacks) and H206 asset growth (dilution). Clipped [-0.5, 1.0]. Sector-neutral top 20%, monthly rebalance.
